Data Engineer, Freight Analytics (invented ad for tests)

We move containers across Europe and need a data engineer to keep our pipelines reliable.
You will own our nightly batch jobs and the scheduler that runs them, reduce failures,
and build data feeds for our tracking and shipment teams.

Must have: Python, SQL, a scheduler such as Airflow, Linux, git.
Nice to have: experience in logistics or shipment tracking, Kubernetes.
